profile_text.body:
Luma AI is a creative AI platform founded in 2021 and headquartered in Redwood City, California. The company describes itself as focused on video generation and image creation, and characterizes its team as lean and high-achieving, working from Palo Alto on what it calls the future of creative intelligence. It describes its platform as trusted by leading agencies and brands.

The company's core products are two video generation models, Ray and Uni, which it describes as powering end-to-end creative workflows through AI agents. Uni-1 is presented as a brand intelligence model capable of understanding style references, character references, and visual grounding, carrying those elements across generated assets. Luma AI has also announced a collaboration with Wonder Project on a production services venture described as combining generative AI with traditional filmmaking.

The site's held facts list Luma AI under the Video Generation and Editing category, with 3D and video generation noted as its primary focus. The company has a notable legal exposure footprint, with 161 cases recorded in California, though no specific litigation details are provided in the available data.
